description: List Exeris SDK annotations from the authoring contract: name, qualified name, package, targets, retention, and purpose. Supports optional filtering by package (e.g. 'system', 'security', 'capability', or full package name), target (e.g. 'METHOD', 'TYPE', 'FIELD'), or query string.

package.description: Optional package filter, e.g. 'system', 'security', 'capability', or full package name.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search string matching annotation name or purpose.

name: sdk-list_annotations
